title.narrative: EU Justice and Legal Empowerment Programme in Vietnam (EU JULE): PAGoDA with UNDP

description.narrative: The PAGoDA mechanism has the objective of contributing to: increase public awareness and understanding of rights and how to invoke those rights; increase access to legal advice, assistance and representation in both civil and criminal matters; improvement of enabling legislative and regulatory framework for legal empowerment and access to justice; and enhancement of integrity and transparency in the justice sector.
